verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community note that ClickUp has real-time chat, plus a bare first-party 'Chat' product listing. Together they imply live message delivery in Chat, but nothing documents teammates' edits to tasks, docs or views propagating instantly across open sessions. Other 'real-time' mentions cover AI context or third-party integrations (Slack, Figma), not in-app session sync. Missing for 10: documentation of live sync for tasks, docs and views across sessions, co-editing or presence indicators, and hands-on corroboration of no-refresh updates.
